# FINAL CONSOLIDATION: recompute every headline number in one self-contained run
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections, math, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",40)
AA="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
S="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
def page(q,size=500,maxrec=4000):
    r=requests.get(S,params={"query":q,"format":"json","size":size},timeout=180); out=[]
    while True:
        j=r.json(); out+=j["results"]
        n=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not n or len(out)>=maxrec: break
        r=requests.get(n,timeout=180)
    return out
res=page("(reviewed:true) AND (organism_id:9606) AND (ft_signal:*) AND (fragment:false)")
EXP=[];ALLSP=[]
for e in res:
    sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
    for f in e.get("features",[]):
        if f["type"]!="Signal": continue
        cds={ev.get("evidenceCode") for ev in f.get("evidences",[])}; en=f["location"]["end"].get("value")
        if en is None or en<15 or en>len(sq)-5: continue
        ALLSP.append((en,sq))
        if "ECO:0000269" in cds: EXP.append((en,sq))
sa=page('(reviewed:true) AND (organism_id:9606) AND (ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor for type II") AND NOT (ft_signal:*) AND (fragment:false)',maxrec=2000)
ANCH=[e["sequence"]["value"] for e in sa
      for t in [[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane" and "type II" in f.get("description","")]]
      if t and 2<=t[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]<=45 and len(e["sequence"]["value"])>=80]
bgc=collections.Counter()
for en,sq in ALLSP: bgc.update([c for c in sq[en:] if c in idx])
bg=np.array([bgc[a]/sum(bgc.values()) for a in AA])
POS=list(range(-13,0))+[1,2]
def win(sq,si):
    w=[]
    for p in POS:
        i=si+p if p<0 else si+p-1
        if i<0 or i>=len(sq): return None
        w.append(sq[i])
    return "".join(w)
M=np.zeros((len(POS),20)); nt=0
for en,sq in EXP:
    w=win(sq,en)
    if w is None or any(c not in idx for c in w): continue
    nt+=1
    for k,c in enumerate(w): M[k,idx[c]]+=1
LO=np.log2(((M+20*bg)/(nt+20))/bg)
def pwm(sq,si):
    w=win(sq,si)
    return np.nan if (w is None or any(c not in idx for c in w)) else float(sum(LO[k,idx[c]] for k,c in enumerate(w)))
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
HE=dict(A=0.11,C=-0.13,D=3.49,E=2.68,F=-0.32,G=0.74,H=2.06,I=-0.60,K=2.71,L=-0.55,M=-0.10,N=2.05,P=2.23,Q=2.36,R=2.58,S=0.84,T=0.52,V=-0.31,W=0.30,Y=0.68)
dG=lambda s: sum(HE.get(c,0) for c in s); kdm=lambda s: sum(KD.get(c,0) for c in s)/max(len(s),1)
KR=lambda s: sum(1 for c in s if c in "KR")
def feats(sq):
    b=None
    for i in range(0,min(45,len(sq)-19)+1):
        v=dG(sq[i:i+19])
        if b is None or v<b[0]: b=(v,i+1,i+19)
    dg,hs,he=b
    cd=[(pwm(sq,t),t) for t in range(max(14,he-5),min(he+12,len(sq)-3)+1)]; cd=[c for c in cd if not math.isnan(c[0])]
    if not cd: return None
    sc,si=max(cd)
    return dict(dG19=dg,h_start=hs,h_end=he,n_len=hs-1,n_KR=KR(sq[:hs-1]),dKR=KR(sq[:hs-1])-KR(sq[he:he+15]),
                site=si,delta=si-he,pwm=sc,creg_kd=kdm(sq[si-6:si]),P3=sq[si-3],P1=sq[si-1],
                ctx=sq[max(0,si-6):si]+"|"+sq[si:si+3])
X=[];y=[]
for en,sq in EXP:
    f=feats(sq)
    if f: X.append(f); y.append(1)
for sq in ANCH:
    f=feats(sq)
    if f: X.append(f); y.append(0)
F=pd.DataFrame(X); y=np.array(y)
cols=["dG19","h_start","n_len","n_KR","dKR","delta","pwm","creg_kd"]
clf=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000))
oof=cross_val_predict(clf,F[cols],y,cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0),method="predict_proba")[:,1]
auc=roc_auc_score(y,oof); clf.fit(F[cols],y)
par=requests.get(S,params={"query":"(gene:AADAC OR gene:AADACL2 OR gene:AADACL3 OR gene:AADACL4 OR gene:NCEH1) AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true","format":"json","size":20},timeout=60).json()["results"]
P={e.get("genes",[{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value"):e["sequence"]["value"] for e in par}
rows=[]
for g,s in P.items():
    f=feats(s); f["gene"]=g; f["p_SP"]=float(clf.predict_proba(pd.DataFrame([f])[cols])[:,1])
    f["dG_pct_among_SP"]=round(float((F.dG19[y==1]<f["dG19"]).mean()*100),2)
    f["pSP_pct_among_SP"]=round(float((oof[y==1]<f["p_SP"]).mean()*100),2)
    rows.append(f)
FAM=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("gene").loc[["AADACL4","AADACL3","AADACL2","AADAC","NCEH1"]]
print("MODEL: SP(n=%d, ECO:0000269) vs type II anchor(n=%d); 5-fold CV AUC=%.3f"%(y.sum(),(1-y).sum(),auc))
print("verified-SP reference: dG19 median %.2f, 5th pct %.2f, min %.2f | p_SP median %.2f, 5th pct %.2f"
      %(F.dG19[y==1].median(),np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5),F.dG19[y==1].min(),np.median(oof[y==1]),np.percentile(oof[y==1],5)))
print("anchor reference: dG19 median %.2f | p_SP median %.2f, 95th pct %.2f"
      %(F.dG19[y==0].median(),np.median(oof[y==0]),np.percentile(oof[y==0],95)))
print("\n=== FINAL FAMILY TABLE ===")
print(FAM[["h_start","h_end","dG19","dG_pct_among_SP","n_KR","dKR","site","delta","ctx","P3","P1","pwm","creg_kd","p_SP","pSP_pct_among_SP"]].round(2).to_string())
# orthologs
rr=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/homology/symbol/human/AADACL4",params={"content-type":"application/json","type":"orthologues","sequence":"protein"},timeout=180).json()
O={}
for o in rr["data"][0]["homologies"]:
    if o["type"]!="ortholog_one2one": continue
    s=o["target"]["align_seq"].replace("-","")
    if o["target"]["perc_id"]<45 or not s.startswith("M") or not(350<len(s)<460): continue
    O.setdefault(o["target"]["species"],s)
OF=pd.DataFrame([feats(s) for s in O.values()]); OF["p_SP"]=clf.predict_proba(OF[cols])[:,1]
thr5=np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5)
print("\northologs n=%d | dG19 median %.2f | %d/%d (%.0f%%) below the verified-SP 5th percentile (%.2f) | p_SP<0.5 in %d/%d"
      %(len(OF),OF.dG19.median(),(OF.dG19<thr5).sum(),len(OF),100*(OF.dG19<thr5).mean(),thr5,(OF.p_SP<0.5).sum(),len(OF)))
# final figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.8))
COL={"AADACL4":"#C8102E","AADACL3":"#E87722","AADACL2":"#7A52C7","AADAC":"#1B7F79","NCEH1":"#1F4E9C"}
a=ax[0]
parts=[F.dG19[y==1],F.dG19[y==0],OF.dG19]
a.boxplot(parts,labels=["verified\nsignal peptides\n(n=%d)"%int(y.sum()),"type II\nsignal anchors\n(n=%d)"%int((1-y).sum()),"AADACL4\northologs\n(n=%d)"%len(OF)],showfliers=False,widths=.5)
for g in COL: a.scatter(1.0,FAM.loc[g,"dG19"],color=COL[g],s=70,zorder=5,edgecolor="k")
for i,g in enumerate(COL):
    a.annotate(g,(1.0,FAM.loc[g,"dG19"]),xytext=(1.38,FAM.loc[g,"dG19"]),fontsize=8,color=COL[g],fontweight="bold",
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-",color=COL[g],lw=.8))
a.axhline(thr5,ls="--",color="#44648C",lw=1)
a.set_ylabel("19-residue insertion free energy proxy (kcal/mol)")
a.set_title("a  Insertion energetics: AADACL4 is anchor-like, not SP-like",fontsize=10)
b=ax[1]
b.boxplot([oof[y==1],oof[y==0],OF.p_SP],labels=["verified\nsignal peptides","type II\nsignal anchors","AADACL4\northologs"],showfliers=False,widths=.5)
for g in COL: b.scatter(1.0,FAM.loc[g,"p_SP"],color=COL[g],s=70,zorder=5,edgecolor="k")
for g in COL:
    b.annotate("%s %.2f"%(g,FAM.loc[g,"p_SP"]),(1.0,FAM.loc[g,"p_SP"]),xytext=(1.34,FAM.loc[g,"p_SP"]),fontsize=8,color=COL[g],
               fontweight="bold",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-",color=COL[g],lw=.8))
b.axhline(.5,ls=":",color="k",lw=1)
b.set_ylabel("P(cleaved signal peptide)")
b.set_title("b  Calibrated classifier, 5-fold CV AUC = %.3f"%auc,fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
